incident-bot: [PAGE] 1791112222 - spike in 500s + p99 latency for /v1/generate (ap-northeast-1). Symptoms: batch queue backlog, KV cache decode errors, quant-kernel processes OOM-ing and falling back to CPU. Auto-notifying #eng-oncall.

Priya K: I'm oncall. Paging Mateo and Hana. Mateo can you take runtime lead?

Mateo R: on it. pulling traces and tailing runtime logs. can someone paste recent deploys in ap-northeast-1?

deploy-bot: deploy log: 1791110000 - promoted quant-kernel:v2026.03.14 -> 30% canary (ap-northeast-1). 1791108000 - config change: include model_variant in kv_cache key.

Hana (SRE): seeing batch queue length hitting 12k for inference-pool-22 and backpressure causing client timeouts. alerts show kv_cache.unmarshal_errors rising ~12:15 UTC.

Mateo R: logs on node-a3: 
```
ERR kv_cache: unmarshal_error: unexpected-header-version=2 expected=1
ERR quant-kernel: oom while decoding quant table
WARN batch: dropped request after enqueue timeout
```
I suspect a mix of stale KV entries with older serialization and a quant kernel that changed memory layout which trips OOMs when attempting to deserialize dense kv blobs.

Priya K: immediate mitigation options? Hana suggestions?

Hana (SRE): safe quick actions: 1) flip kv_cache.enabled=false for affected routes, 2) set pool.max_concurrency=1 or reduce batching window, 3) scale additional non-canary nodes, 4) rollback kernel canary. Priority: toggle flag + reduce batch size.

Priya K: executing flag changes now.

Priya K: `curl -X POST https://ops-api.redwood/v1/flags -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"region":"ap-northeast-1","route":"/v1/generate","kv_cache.enabled":false,"pool.batch_latency_ms":5}'`

deploy-bot: flag-change/1791112245 by Priya K -> kv_cache.enabled=false, pool.batch_latency_ms=5 for /v1/generate (ap-northeast-1).

infra-bot: autoscale request -> spin up 3 nodes in pool inference-pool-22 (reason: backpressure).

Mateo R: after flags and scale, error rates dropping. p99 improved from ~3.8s -> 220ms. some nodes still logging unmarshal errors from in-memory cache; I'll cycle those canary nodes to clear process state.

Olaf D: I'll start the graceful restart on canary subset (node-a2,a3). Running drain -> restart.

deploy-bot: maintenance: restart sequence started for nodes [node-a2,node-a3] in inference-pool-22

Tom (CS): support queue: 9 customer incidents opened, 3 timed-out requests flagged as P1. I'm sending a customer-impact note to affected customers. link: https://docs.redwood/internal/support/incidents/1791112222-affected

Mateo R: restarts completed; post-restart logs show no unmarshal errors. tail latency back to normal. marking incident mitigated pending RCA.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigated at 1791112600. Suspected cause: incompatible KV serialization version + quant-kernel memory layout changes causing OOMs during deserialisation -> batch queue pileup.

Priya K: Thanks all. We need a postmortem and tracked remediation. Propose 40m postmortem tomorrow 2026-03-21 09:00 JST. Action items (owners + suggested due dates):
- Mateo: complete RCA and include minimal reproducer + node logs in postmortem doc. due: 2026-03-24
- Eng-runtime: add compatibility test for KV value serialization across kernel versions and model_variant key permutations. owner: eng-runtime team. due: 2026-04-10
- Eng-runtime: add defensive path in deserialiser to fail-fast and not OOM on malformed/oversize payloads. owner: Mateo. due: 2026-03-31
- Eng-sre (Hana): new alerts for kv_cache.unmarshal_error > 0.05% over 2m and batch_queue_length > 5000. due: 2026-03-26
- Infra (Olaf): add a canary gating rule to block kernel promotion if kv compatibility tests fail. due: 2026-03-29
- Product/CS (Tom): finalize customer communication and confirm OK-to-close with impacted accounts. due: 2026-03-23

Tom (CS): noted. I'll draft the message and run by legal if needed.

Mateo R: initial RCA notes: quant-kernel v2026.03.14 changed the internal packed layout for float quant tables (re-ordered segments to optimize decode). KV entries serialized under older kernel encoded a header version=1; a config change earlier rolled model_variant into the cache key which meant many existing entries used a different key namespace; new kernel attempted to load some stale blobs and hit unexpected header version -> deserialiser fell back to a heavy decode path that allocated large buffers and in some cases triggered OOMs. Reproducer will write old-blob -> new-kernel decode path to validate.

Priya K: doc link created: https://docs.redwood/internal/incidents/1791112222-kv-quant-rca. Please add logs and reproducer. I'll schedule the postmortem and add the invite.

-- 3 DAYS LATER (remediation tracker updates) --

Priya K: quick sync here for status updates. please paste short updates.

Mateo R: PR opened: eng-runtime#559 - add defensive deserialiser with size caps + early reject of unknown header versions. includes unit tests. awaiting review. estimated merge 4 days.

Eng-runtime (auto): PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/eng-runtime/pulls/559

Hana (SRE): alert rules created in staging; PR for infra dashboards open: eng-infra#113.

Olaf D: canary gate PR opened: eng-infra#114 - blocks promotion when kv-compat test fails. needs QA.

Tom (CS): customer comms sent; 6 customers acknowledged. no escalations.

Priya K: follow-ups: Mateo to publish rewriter/migration plan for stale kv entries (safe-mode first: report-only then rewrite with throttled concurrency). Hana to add runbook step for emergency kv-disable and rolling restart. Olaf to coordinate deploy window for migration.

Mateo R: plan: step 1 = read-only verifier that checks header versions and key namespaces; step 2 = rewrite tool that re-encodes legacy blobs into new format behind feature flag with rate-limiting; step 3 = integrate verifier into canary tests. I'll split into two PRs. rough target: verifier by 2026-04-04, rewriter MVP by 2026-04-18.

Hana (SRE): adding runbook entry now. PR: eng-sre#77. includes checklist: toggle kv_cache flag, reduce batch window, restart canary nodes, monitor synthetic.

Priya K: great. we'll keep this thread as remediation tracker. once verifier + rewriter + canary gates are in place and CS confirms customer notifications closed, we'll mark incident as remediated. thanks for the fast response and clear owners. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident closed 1791112790 - monitoring in place, mitigation verified.

-- 2 WEEKS LATER (final closure updates) --

Mateo R: verifier PR merged, canary tests updated to run verifier pre-promotion. rewriter MVP PR opened for review: eng-runtime#573. migration runbook drafted.

Olaf D: canary gate merged; promotions now blocked until kv-compat checks pass.

Hana (SRE): runbook published and included in oncall handbook. alerts live in production.

Tom (CS): all impacted customers confirmed receipt and OK-to-close. closing support tickets.

Priya K: marking this incident as remediated in tracker and adding final note to postmortem doc. great teamwork. closing thread. :heart:
notes: incident paging -> live mitigation -> postmortem scheduling and remediation tracking for kv cache + quantization regression. follow-ups and closure updates included.
